gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-heebo: Metamorphous spaces its letters generously, with a high midline. Heebo, a plain sans, has a tall central band, so it can go a touch smaller without losing its footing.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One reads like laser-cut sheet, with huge lowercase eyes. Page after page it holds one stroke width, while Metamorphous shows only a faint modulation if you look closely.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Commanding at the top, contemporary underneath, and clearly two different voices. Metamorphous does its best work with softly modulated strokes, while Noto Sans Tamil does its best with magnified-looking text and terminals stopping far from the stem.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-vai: Modern and approachable underneath, with a commanding heading perched on top. The best thing here is how the gentle weight shifts in Metamorphous meet the solid-block words of Noto Sans Vai.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hind-siliguri: Wide-tracked and open-curved, Offside holds one level beat. Hind Siliguri, a plain sans, hums along at constant line weight, its rounds gapping like a cracked bangle on the page.
gen-gf-offside-gf-huninn: Expressive on top, modern underneath, with plenty of presence. The best thing is the widely tracked, open curves of Offside against Huninn, a sans-serif whose lowercase rises close to cap height.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-batak: Wide-tracked curves that never quite close: that's Offside. Offside is best at a level, untapered beat, while Noto Sans Batak, a sans-serif, is best at an open e that never squeezes shut and a towering x-height.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Offside is all open curves and widely spaced letters. Noto Sans Chorasmian, a sans with a large x-height and short ascenders, would read steadily down a page without crowding.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Expressive first, then modern: that is the order here. Offside draws strokes like a bent paperclip, and Noto Sans Ethiopic, a plain sans with hanging c terminals, gives them a sturdy tall lowercase to land on.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Approachable and expressive, with a clear split in temperament. Offside is strongest at widely tracked, level letters, while Noto Sans Glagolitic, a plain sans, is happiest with open round forms that stay clear at small sizes.
